title: Cross-Domain Intelligence Synthesizer — Capability specification
body: Public edition. Public research and engineering knowledge, fact-checked reference. Public edition. Public research and engineering knowledge, fact-checked reference. Cross-Domain Intelligence Synthesizer is a apex creation capability. Purpose: combines techniques from different disciplines to discover useful new approaches.. Inputs: a defined objective with constraints and acceptance criteria. Outputs: the specified artifact — code, design, analysis, or verified result — plus its evidence package. Constraints: available compute, data, tools, and permissions. Expected behavior: the capability either produces a verified result or reports exactly what is missing. Proposed capabilities and research directions — not claims that these already exist or can all be achieved with current technology. 'Boundless' means the catalog and its combinations can keep expanding; actual execution still depends on available compute, storage, data, software, permissions, and physical resources.

demo.title: Executable fragment runs: Ranked retrieval fragment
demo.code:
function rankSearch(docs,q){var qs=q.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);if(!qs.length)return [];return docs.map(function(d){var t=d.toLowerCase();var s=qs.reduce(function(a,w){return a+(t.split(w).length-1);},0);return {doc:d,score:s};}).filter(function(x){return x.score>0;}).sort(function(a,b){return b.score-a.score;});}
var r=rankSearch(['apple pie','apple tart','banana'],'apple');J(r);assert(r.length===2&&r[0].score>=r[1].score,'rank');
